description: Contains detailed definitions of Dialogflow CX entity types, including their values and synonyms.

schema.name: runtime
schema.description: The timestamp when the data extraction process was run.

schema.name: run_guid
schema.description: A unique identifier for each execution run of the data extraction process.

schema.name: entity_type_id
schema.description: The unique identifier (UUID) for the Dialogflow CX Entity Type.

schema.name: display_name
schema.description: The human-readable display name for the entity type as shown in the Dialogflow CX console.

schema.name: kind
schema.description: The kind of entity type, indicating how it matches input. Common values include KIND_MAP, KIND_LIST, and KIND_REGEXP.

schema.name: auto_expansion_mode
schema.description: Indicates whether the entity type can be automatically expanded to cover synonyms. Values can be AUTO_EXPANSION_MODE_DEFAULT or AUTO_EXPANSION_MODE_UNSPECIFIED.

schema.name: fuzzy_extraction
schema.description: Indicates if fuzzy matching is enabled for the entity type, allowing for approximate matches.

schema.name: redact
schema.description: Indicates if the extracted entity value should be redacted in logs and data storage.

schema.name: entity_value
schema.description: The specific canonical value for an entity entry within the entity type.

schema.name: synonyms
schema.description: A list of alternative strings (synonyms) that map to the canonical entity_value.
